title: Multi-layer Predictor Feedback Design for Nonlinear Integro-Differential Equations with State-dependent Input Delays
summary: We develop a novel multi-layer predictor-feedback to achieve exact compensation of state-dependent input delay of general nonlinear integro-differential equations. The system of interest is an unconventional mixed Partial Differential Equation (PDE)-Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE) system, in which a nonlinear ODE is actuated through an inhomogeneous advection PDE. Moreover, the propagation speed of the PDE depends on a moving window integral of the ODE state.
